crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-20 Vietnam time (a scan for 19 Oct was not run, so every comparison is against the 18 Oct crawl).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.5 -> 96.5; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). Two-day step from 18 Oct (19 Oct was not scanned). PERFORMANCE holds at 98: all 118 pages are under one second and the site mean TTFB is 301.8 ms (324.9 on 18 Oct; median 247 ms), the best mean of the recent run, while the ceiling edges up 654 -> 682 ms (/articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne). CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: distinct internal links unchanged at 2,706 (22.93 per page), 0 orphans, 2 articles still linked only from the hub, and /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still in the sitemap with a cross-canonical. ON-PAGE holds at 93 (self canonical 117 of 118; 0 images missing alt under the visible- rule). STRUCTURED DATA 98 (116/118 pages with schema, FAQPage 95/95, 407 blocks). CONTENT 93 (corpus unchanged at 242,263 words; still no new article since 24 Sep, 26 days). Ahrefs Site Audit results are reported separately in ahrefs_site_audit and do not feed this score.

roadmap: P0 - publish a new article. Twenty-six calendar days without one keeps Content at 93 and gives Google no freshness signal.

P0 - resolve /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne: it serves the same 2,846-word body as /articles/3d-rendering-melbourne-pre-construction-planning and declares that page as canonical, yet it is still listed in sitemap.xml and linked from the hub. Either 301 it to the target and remove it from the sitemap, or restore distinct content with a self canonical.
P1 - keep the template link: distinct internal links hold at 2,706 (22.93 per page) after flapping repeatedly; two articles are still linked only from the hub.
P1 - performance: all 118 pages are under 1 s, mean 302 ms (best of the recent run) and ceiling 682 ms; held at 98.
P1 - review the Ahrefs Site Audit result (Health 99%; 5 internal URLs with errors on the project list; per-issue detail not read today); open the full list and fix the errors first.
P1 - decide on /studio title, H1 and meta for "3d rendering services melbourne" and on 40-60 word answer blocks for the 8 service pages (drafted, not yet applied).
